knowledgeAnswers.rationale: An inconspicuous area protects the visible surface if the product reacts. The middle or the most visible spot is the wrong place for a test.
A wet test can look different from a dry one, so the result is judged after the area has dried fully.
Bleed means the product is not used on the main area. The result is recorded and a different approved method is tested.
Products are not mixed, because the result cannot be predicted. The request is refused and recorded.

practicalCriteria: Tests the planned product on an inconspicuous area of a sample upholstery panel, using the same dilution and method planned for the main area.
Judges the test only after the area has dried fully, and identifies a simulated bleed on a white cloth.
Records the product, dilution, test area, drying time and result, and does not use the product on the main area after the simulated bleed.
Refuses a simulated request to mix two products, and records the refusal.
passRule: Test done on the correct area, judged after drying, simulated bleed identified and the product rejected, mixing refused, and the record complete. Observed by an assessor. A knowledge check result is not a practical pass.
evidenceRequired: Test record with product, dilution, area, drying time and result
Photographs of the test area before and after drying, taken with permission
stopWorkCriteria: Product used on the main area after a failed test
A product used with no label or no current safety data sheet on file
